title: Layer-Isolated Evaluation: Gating the Deterministic Scaffold of a Production LLM Agent with a No-LLM, Regression-Locked Test Harness
title_zh: 层隔离评估：用无 LLM、回归锁定测试框架门控生产级 LLM Agent 的确定性脚手架
abstract_en: End-to-end task-success is the dominant way to evaluate LLM agents, but one aggregate number tells you that an agent regressed, not where. We present layer-isolated evaluation: a deployed ordering agent is decomposed into a fixed taxonomy of layers (ontology, intent, routing, decomposition, escalation, safety, memory, and cross-cutting envelope/defense), each exercised by its own assertion slice in a deterministic, no-LLM "pure" mode. The pure suite (238 cases across 23 slices; 225 run in 2.39 s, ~10 ms/case) runs in CI on every change against a locked per-slice baseline. We validate by controlled regression injection, degrading one layer at a time across seven non-safety layers. The effect we did not design in is masking: the aggregate pass-rate barely moves (-1.7 to -5.9 pp for six local regressions), while the matching slice craters (-25 to -91 pp). A layer's slice reacting to its own fault is partly by construction; the measured results are (i) the aggregate masking and (ii) that damage stays off the other slices: the injected layer's slice is the single worst-hit in 5 of 7 cases and top-3 in 7 of 7 (mean rank 1.29 of 19). Localization replicates on a second, structurally different tenant (Starbucks SG): all seven matching slices crater, so it is not a single-catalog artifact. We position it as a concrete, deterministic instantiation of the component-level evaluation EDDOps prescribes but leaves unimplemented, with CheckList as ancestor and as the deterministic mirror image of whole-workflow stochastic mutation testing. Our contributions: (a) a fully decomposed, sub-second, no-LLM per-layer harness for a production agent, (b) a coverage-honesty test-adequacy criterion that refuses to score an unexercised layer, and (c) the regression-injection demonstration that per-slice baseline-locked gates localize regressions an aggregate metric masks.
abstract_zh: 本文针对 LLM Agent 评估中过度依赖端到端任务成功率的问题提出 layer-isolated evaluation。作者将一个已部署的点单 Agent 分解为固定层级：ontology、intent、routing、decomposition、escalation、safety、memory，以及跨层 envelope/defense，并为每层设计独立断言切片，在确定性、无 LLM 的“pure”模式下测试。该测试套件包含 23 个切片、238 个用例，其中 225 个用例可在 2.39 秒内运行，约 10 ms/例，并在 CI 中针对每次变更与锁定的逐切片基线对比。通过对 7 个非安全层逐一注入受控回归，作者发现端到端总通过率仅轻微下降，而对应切片会大幅崩溃，说明聚合指标会掩盖局部故障；同时故障影响大多局限在对应切片，有助于定位。该结果还在结构不同的第二租户 Starbucks SG 上复现。论文将该方法定位为 EDDOps 所倡导组件级评估的一个确定性落地实现，并与 CheckList 及随机工作流变异测试形成对照。
key_points_zh: 提出 layer-isolated evaluation，将生产级点单 LLM Agent 拆成 ontology、intent、routing、decomposition、escalation、safety、memory 等层，并分别建立断言切片。
测试在 no-LLM 的确定性 pure 模式下运行，238 个用例、23 个切片，225 个用例仅需 2.39 秒，适合接入 CI 做逐变更回归门控。
受控回归注入显示，端到端聚合通过率只下降 1.7 到 5.9 个百分点，但对应层切片下降 25 到 91 个百分点，证明总指标会显著掩盖局部退化。
故障定位效果较强：注入层的对应切片在 5/7 个实验中是受影响最严重切片，在 7/7 个实验中位列前三，平均排名 1.29/19。
在结构不同的 Starbucks SG 租户上复现实验，7 个匹配切片均显著崩溃，说明该方法并非依赖单一目录或单一业务配置。

llm_assessment.comment: Highly practical evaluation infrastructure for production ordering agents, though it contributes more to agent reliability than search or recommendation.
